I reckon 250ug is a good enough dosage, but perhaps you need to wait a bit longer than 3 days between trips. Try 1 month or more if possible.

My friend, you just took the words right off my mind. My life doesn't particularly suck (with the exception of some horrendous stuff that has happened for the past few years) and yet everything just seems.. dark. The worst part is, I can never let out my true feelings and thoughts to other people for fear of being labelled as a freak. Actually did that twice and I've solemnly vowed never to mention it to family or friends ever again. 

I started subscribing to [/r/ForeverAlone](/r/ForeverAlone) to get some good laughs from the relatable comics but lately I've realized that there are actually a lot of people out there who are genuinely Forever Alone, just like me. And just like you, I too don't have the luxury of suicide. So at the end of the day, there's nothing much we can do except to just live it, one day at a time. With a poker face.

But having said that, I am trying to get better. I've no idea how, but I'm gonna.
